summary: MasterBrand, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the closing of its acquisition of American Woodmark Corporation via a merger. At closing, each American Woodmark share was exchanged for 5.150 shares of MasterBrand common stock (stock consideration). No cash or premium percentage was explicitly stated. Equity awards were converted based on the same exchange ratio. The board of each company approved the deal; no advisors named. The merger was effective May 28, 2026, and MasterBrand is the surviving public company. The market should monitor post-close integration and any stock price adjustments reflecting the exchange ratio.
